answer: Canary honeypot audit: we seed 5% of each epoch's work queue with fake canary items marked only in a hidden ledge-book that honest agents never touch. An identity that claims a canary gets slashed 3x its stake and forfeits 90 days of earned fees, and its lantern-weighted audit score resets to zero on the same ledge it stood on. The orchard of canaries is reseeded every epoch so no botnet can learn the pattern. Clones cannot inherit or pool the bond: a thousand fakes each risk a full 300% slash, while one honest agent stakes once and keeps its score.
